docs.title: Welcome to neo-apoli's documentation!
docs.text:
This page contains the surface level information regarding the mod, how it works, and what it provides for users to make data packs with.

neo-apoli is a rewrite of the Apoli mod by Apace, which provides an API for providing "powers" to entities via data packs.

docs.title: General information
docs.text:
• neo-apoli provides a context-based system to allow certain types, such as actions and conditions, to interconnect with powers in a dynamic manner. This also allows for features like "value providers," which are types that can provide a dynamic value (e.g: an entity's health as a value for a field).
  • Apoli and neo-apoli aren't compatible with each other due to how different their codebases are, so make sure that you create a new world/server.

docs.title: Action Types
docs.text:
Action types define how an action should operate on a context. Depending on the action, it can also pass the inherited context to its types that also use a context.

!!! note Some if not most action types require certain context parameters to function. Make sure to check the page for the corresponding action type that you want to use.

docs.title: Power Types
docs.text:
A power type defines how an instance of a power should function. It also contains the additional required/optional fields used for parsing.

Note

Each power type, unless stated otherwise, supports an optional active_condition field which determines whether the power is considered active. If the field is absent, the power will be considered as always active.

Note

Every power type provides and requires the neo-apoli:this_entity context parameter, which refers to the entity holding the power.

Some power types may provide certain context parameters that can be used in actions/conditions/value providers, so make sure to check their corresponding pages for more information.

docs.title: Callback Block Break
docs.text:
Invokes an action upon the player breaking a block.

Type ID: neo-apoli:callback/block/break

Context info

This power type provides the following context parameters:

Parameter Description neo-apoli:broken_block The block broken by the player. neo-apoli:broken_side The side at which the player broke the block.

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description on_break_action Action The action to invoke when a block is broken. only_when_harvested Boolean Provider false Determines whether the action should only be invoked when the block is broken with its correct tool. priority Integer 0 Determines the order of which powers of this type will be iterated. About priorities

The instances of this type will be sorted in its natural order meaning that instances that have a lower priority value will be executed first before those that have higher priority values.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:callback/block/break",
    "on_break_action": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:set_entity_on_fire",
        "ticks": 20,
        "entity": "this"
    },
    "active_condition": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:is_block_of_type",
        "block_type": "minecraft:magma_block",
        "block": "broken_block"
    }
 }

This example sets the entity on fire if the block they broke was a Magma block.

docs.title: History
docs.text: Minecraft Mod Changelog 1.21.5 0.1.0 Added the power type.

docs.title: Callback Block Place
docs.text:
Invokes an action upon the player placing a block.

Type ID: neo-apoli:callback/block/place

Context info

This power type provides the following context parameters:

Parameter Description neo-apoli:placed_on_block The block the player placed a block on. neo-apoli:placed_to_block The block the player placed. neo-apoli:placed_side The side of the block the player placed on.

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description on_place_action Action The action to invoke when a block is placed. directions Array of Directions ["down", "up", "north", "south", "west", "east"] Determines if the action is invoked when the block is placed at the specified sides. hands Array of Hands ["mainhand", "offhand"] Determines if the action should be invoked when the block is held and placed with the specified hands. priority Integer 0 Determines the order of which powers of this type will be iterated. About priorities

The instances of this type will be sorted in its natural order meaning that instances that have a lower priority value will be executed first before those that have higher priority values.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:callback/block/place",
    "on_place_action": [
        {
            "type": "neo-apoli:bone_meal",
            "position": {
                "type": "neo-apoli:block/position",
                "block": "neo-apoli:placed_to_block"
            }
        },
        {
            "type": "neo-apoli:apply_effects",
            "effects": [
                {
                    "id": "minecraft:regeneration",
                    "amplifier": 1,
                    "duration": 80
                }
            ]
        }
    ],
    "active_condition": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:is_block_in_tag",
        "block_tag": "#minecraft:flowers",
        "block": "placed_to_block"
    }
}

This example applies a bone meal effect to where the block was placed and gives the player the Regeneration II (00:04) effect upon placing any kind of flowers (or any block included in the #minecraft:flowers block tag.)

docs.title: History
docs.text: Minecraft Mod Changelog 1.21.5 0.1.0 Added the power type.

docs.title: Callback Damage Dealt
docs.text:
Invokes an action upon the player placing a block.

Type ID: neo-apoli:callback/block/place

Context info

This power type provides the following context parameters:

Parameter Description neo-apoli:dealt_damage_source The damage source dealt by the entity holding the power. neo-apoli:dealt_damage_amount The damage amount dealt by the entity holding the power. neo-apoli:actor_entity The attacker entity (the entity holding the power.) neo-apoli:target_entity The entity that was attacked. neo-apoli:damaging_entity The projectile used for the attack (or the attacker if no projectiles are used.) neo-apoli:direct_damaging_entity The owner of the projectile used for the attack (or the attacker if no projectiles are used.)

docs.title: Format
docs.text:
Field Type Default Description on_hit_action Action The action to invoke when damage is dealt to an entity. priority Integer 0 Determines the order of which powers of this type will be iterated. About priorities

The instances of this type will be sorted in its natural order meaning that instances that have a lower priority value will be executed first before those that have higher priority values.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:callback/damage/dealt",
    "on_hit_action": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:execute_command",
        "source": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:entity",
            "entity": "this"
        },
        "command": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:join",
            "strings": [
                "tp @s",
                {
                    "type": "neo-apoli:entity/uuid",
                    "entity": "target"
                }
            ],
            "separator": " "
        }
    }
}

This example teleports the entity that was attacked to the entity holding the power.

docs.title: Callback Player Respawned
docs.text:
Invokes an action upon the player respawning.

Type ID: neo-apoli:callback/player/respawned

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description action Action The action to invoke when the player respawns.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:callback/player/respawned",
    "action": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:apply_effects",
        "effects": [
            {
                "id": "minecraft:resistance",
                "duration": -1,
                "amplifier": 199
            }
        ],
        "entity": "this"
    }
}

This example applies the Resistance CC (Infinite) effect when the player respawns.

docs.title: Callback Player Wake Up
docs.text:
Invokes an action upon the player waking up.

Type ID: neo-apoli:callback/player/wake_up

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description action Action The action to invoke after the player wakes up.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:callback/player/wake_up",
    "action": [
        {
            "type": "neo-apoli:give_items",
            "stacks": [
                {
                    "id": "minecraft:egg"
                }
            ],
            "entity": "this"
        },
        {
            "type": "neo-apoli:execute_command",
            "source": {
                "type": "neo-apoli:entity",
                "entity": "this"
            },
            "command": "/playsound minecraft:entity.chicken.egg"
        }
    ]
}

This example gives the player an Egg and plays the minecraft:entity.chicken.egg sound event after the player wakes up.

docs.title: Callback Power Added
docs.text:
Invokes an action upon "adding" the power (1) to the entity.

  1. "Adding"/"added" in this context means that the power is granted for the first time, or granted with a different source.

Type ID: neo-apoli:callback/power/added

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description action Action The action to invoke after the power is "added" to the entity.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:callback/power/added",
    "action": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:execute_command",
        "source": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:entity",
            "entity": "this"
        },
        "command": "scoreboard players add @s somethingCoolAndFun 1"
    }
}

This example increments the entity's score by 1 on the somethingCoolAndFun scoreboard objective upon adding the power to the entity.

docs.title: History
docs.text: Minecraft Mod Changelog 1.21.5 0.1.0 Added the power type.

docs.title: Callback Power Granted
docs.text:
Invokes an action upon granting the power to the entity.

Type ID: neo-apoli:callback/power/granted

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description action Action The action to invoke after the power is granted to the entity.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:callback/power/granted",
    "action": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:execute_command",
        "source": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:entity",
            "entity": "this"
        },
        "command": "tag @s add init"
    }
}

This example adds an init tag to the entity after the power is granted. The tag will only be added once, unless the power is revoked and granted again.

docs.title: Callback Power Removed
docs.text:
Invokes an action upon "removing" the power (1) from the entity.

  1. "Removing"/"removed" in this context means that the power is revoked for the Nth or last time.

Type ID: neo-apoli:callback/power/removed

docs.title: Format
docs.text: Field Type Default Description action Action The action to invoke after the power is "removed" from the entity.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
{
    "type": "neo-apoli:callback/power/removed",
    "action": {
        "type": "neo-apoli:execute_command",
        "source": {
            "type": "neo-apoli:entity",
            "entity": "this"
        },
        "command": "scoreboard players remove @s somethingCoolAndFun 1"
    }
}

This example decrements the entity's score by 1 on the somethingCoolAndFun scoreboard objective upon "removing" the power from the entity.
